outcome: Vaginal microbiota composition (16S rRNA gene sequencing)
Systemic inflammatory markers (neutrophil count, neutrophil percentage, high-sensitivity C-reactive protein, interleukin-6, procalcitonin, erythrocyte sedimentation rate)
cohort: Pregnant women in late gestation undergoing routine prenatal care, classified into GBS-negative (n=19) and GBS-positive (n=20) groups.
finding: GBS colonization significantly disrupts the balance of the vaginal microbiota, leading to a reduction in Lactobacillus dominance and an increase in pathogenic taxa, which is associated with elevated systemic inflammatory markers.
